Sp80053AssessmentMethod.description: One assessment method SP 800-53A gives a control or enhancement, with the objects an assessor selects from: documents and records to examine, people to interview, or mechanisms and activities to test.

assessment_method.description: Which of the three methods this is.

assessment_objects.description: The objects the method is applied to, in the order the publication lists them.

Sp80053AssessmentMethod.title: Sp80053AssessmentMethod

Sp80053AssessmentMethodKind.description: The three assessment methods of SP 800-53A, as its catalog writes them.
Sp80053AssessmentMethodKind.title: Sp80053AssessmentMethodKind

Sp80053AssessmentObjective.description: An assessment objective of SP 800-53A: a determination statement an assessor checks, or a heading that groups the determination statements of one item of the control statement.

objective_label.description: The label SP 800-53A gives the objective, such as AC-02a.[01].

objective_text.description: The determination statement, with the same placeholders for parameters as the control statement. A heading has none.

sub_objectives.description: The objectives grouped under this one, in order.

Sp80053AssessmentObjective.title: Sp80053AssessmentObjective

Sp80053Baseline.description: One of the four control baselines SP 800-53B defines: the controls and enhancements selected for systems at the low, moderate or high impact level, or for privacy.

baseline_controls.description: The controls and enhancements the baseline selects, by identifier, in the order the catalog gives them.

baseline_level.description: Which of the four baselines this is.

title.description: The name SP 800-53 gives the family, control or control enhancement, or the title NIST's profile gives the baseline.

Sp80053Baseline.title: Sp80053Baseline

Sp80053BaselineLevel.description: The four control baselines SP 800-53B defines.
Sp80053BaselineLevel.title: Sp80053BaselineLevel

Sp80053Catalog.description: One release of the control catalog as a whole: its families, each holding its controls and their enhancements, the baselines that select from them, and the publications the catalog lists.

catalog_references.description: The publications the catalog's references list, most of which a control cites.

catalog_release.description: The release of Revision 5 the catalog carries, as NIST numbers it, such as 5.2.0.

control_baselines.description: The control baselines of SP 800-53B that select from the catalog.

control_families.description: The twenty control families, in the order SP 800-53 gives them.

Sp80053Catalog.title: Sp80053Catalog

Sp80053Control.description: A security or privacy control: a safeguard with an identifier, a statement of what it requires, a discussion, parameters the organization defines, related controls, references, the assessment objective and methods SP 800-53A gives it, and its enhancements. A control Revision 5 withdrew keeps its identifier and says where it went.

assessment_methods.description: The assessment methods SP 800-53A gives the control or enhancement, each with the objects it is applied to.

assessment_objective.description: The assessment objective SP 800-53A gives the control or enhancement: the determination statements an assessor checks, nested as the statement's items are.

contributes_to_assurance.description: True where NIST's reference data marks the control or enhancement as one that contributes to assurance; absent otherwise.

control_discussion.description: The discussion that follows the statement: context and guidance that help apply the control, which the publication does not require.

control_enhancements.description: The control's enhancements. A knowledge bundle relates an enhancement to its control with isPartOf instead.

control_identifier.description: The control's identifier, such as AC-2.

control_parameters.description: The organization-defined parameters the statement leaves to the organization, in the order the catalog gives them.

control_references.description: The publications the control or enhancement cites, by the labels the catalog's references carry, such as SP 800-12 or OMB A-130.

control_statement.description: The control statement: what the control or enhancement requires, as one text, a lettered or numbered list of items, or both.

control_status.description: The status the catalog gives a control or enhancement that Revision 5 withdrew. An active one carries none.

implementation_level.description: Who implements the control or enhancement, as NIST's reference data marks it: the organization, the system, or both.

incorporated_into.description: For a withdrawn control or enhancement, what it was incorporated into, as the publication states it.

moved_to.description: For a withdrawn control or enhancement, the control or enhancement it moved to, as the publication states it.

related_control_ids.description: The controls and enhancements the publication lists as related, by identifier.

title.description: The name SP 800-53 gives the family, control or control enhancement, or the title NIST's profile gives the baseline.

withdrawal_reason.description: For a withdrawn control or enhancement that the publication neither moved nor incorporated, what it says instead, such as that the enhancement is addressed through tailoring.

Sp80053Control.title: Sp80053Control

Sp80053ControlEnhancement.description: A control enhancement: added functionality or strength for a control, with an identifier of its own, which the publication and other documents cite apart from the control. It carries what a control carries, and names the control or enhancement it requires.

assessment_methods.description: The assessment methods SP 800-53A gives the control or enhancement, each with the objects it is applied to.

assessment_objective.description: The assessment objective SP 800-53A gives the control or enhancement: the determination statements an assessor checks, nested as the statement's items are.

contributes_to_assurance.description: True where NIST's reference data marks the control or enhancement as one that contributes to assurance; absent otherwise.

control_discussion.description: The discussion that follows the statement: context and guidance that help apply the control, which the publication does not require.

control_parameters.description: The organization-defined parameters the statement leaves to the organization, in the order the catalog gives them.

control_references.description: The publications the control or enhancement cites, by the labels the catalog's references carry, such as SP 800-12 or OMB A-130.

control_statement.description: The control statement: what the control or enhancement requires, as one text, a lettered or numbered list of items, or both.

control_status.description: The status the catalog gives a control or enhancement that Revision 5 withdrew. An active one carries none.

enhancement_id.description: The enhancement's identifier, such as AC-2(1).

implementation_level.description: Who implements the control or enhancement, as NIST's reference data marks it: the organization, the system, or both.

incorporated_into.description: For a withdrawn control or enhancement, what it was incorporated into, as the publication states it.

moved_to.description: For a withdrawn control or enhancement, the control or enhancement it moved to, as the publication states it.

related_control_ids.description: The controls and enhancements the publication lists as related, by identifier.

required_controls.description: The controls and enhancements that must be implemented for the enhancement to apply, as NIST's catalog links them: its own control, and for SC-42(2) also SC-42(1).

title.description: The name SP 800-53 gives the family, control or control enhancement, or the title NIST's profile gives the baseline.

withdrawal_reason.description: For a withdrawn control or enhancement that the publication neither moved nor incorporated, what it says instead, such as that the enhancement is addressed through tailoring.

Sp80053ControlEnhancement.title: Sp80053ControlEnhancement

Sp80053ControlStatus.description: The one status the catalog marks: withdrawn. A control or enhancement that Revision 5 keeps carries no status.
Sp80053ControlStatus.title: Sp80053ControlStatus

Sp80053Family.description: One of the twenty families SP 800-53 sorts its controls into, such as Access Control or Supply Chain Risk Management.

description.description: What the family is about, in the words of whoever records it. SP 800-53 gives the Program Management family an overview of its own, and the other families none.

family_controls.description: The controls of the family. A knowledge bundle relates a control to its family with isPartOf instead.

family_id.description: The family's two letters, such as AC for Access Control.

title.description: The name SP 800-53 gives the family, control or control enhancement, or the title NIST's profile gives the baseline.

Sp80053Family.title: Sp80053Family

Sp80053ImplementationLevel.description: Who implements a control or enhancement, as NIST's reference data marks it.
Sp80053ImplementationLevel.title: Sp80053ImplementationLevel

Sp80053Parameter.description: An organization-defined parameter: a value the control statement leaves to the organization, either an assignment the organization fills in or a selection from the choices the publication lists. SP 800-53A labels each parameter but the ones that aggregate others, and gives most a guideline.

aggregated_parameters.description: For a parameter that stands for several, the parameters it aggregates, by identifier.

alternative_identifiers.description: The identifiers an earlier release of the catalog gave the parameter, such as ac-1_prm_2 for ac-01_odp.03.

alternative_label.description: The label SP 800-53 prints where it differs from the one SP 800-53A gives.

assessment_label.description: The label SP 800-53A gives the parameter, such as AC-02_ODP[01]. A parameter that aggregates several has none.

parameter_guidelines.description: The guidelines that say what a value must settle, such as that the frequency of a review is defined.

parameter_id.description: The parameter's identifier in NIST's catalog, such as ac-02_odp.01.

parameter_label.description: For an assignment, what the organization defines, such as personnel or roles.

selection_cardinality.description: For a selection, how many choices the organization picks. The catalog marks one or more, and leaves the slot out when one choice is allowed, which is how OSCAL reads an absent how-many.

selection_choices.description: For a selection, the choices the publication lists, in order.

Sp80053Parameter.title: Sp80053Parameter

Sp80053Reference.description: A publication the catalog's references list, as they list it: its label, its citation and its address.

reference_citation.description: The citation, as the catalog prints it.

reference_label.description: The label the controls cite the publication by, such as SP 800-12.

reference_url.description: The address the catalog gives for the publication.

Sp80053Reference.title: Sp80053Reference

Sp80053SelectionCardinality.description: How many of a selection's choices the organization picks.
Sp80053SelectionCardinality.title: Sp80053SelectionCardinality

Sp80053Statement.description: A control statement: the text of what a control or enhancement requires, and the items it is divided into.

statement_items.description: The lettered or numbered items of the statement, in order, each of which may hold items of its own.

statement_text.description: The statement's own text, before any items. A placeholder of the form {{ insert: param, <identifier> }} marks where an organization-defined parameter is inserted.

Sp80053Statement.title: Sp80053Statement

Sp80053StatementItem.description: One lettered or numbered item of a control statement, which may hold items of its own.

item_label.description: The item's label as the publication prints it, such as a., 1. or (a).

item_text.description: The item's text, with the same placeholders for parameters as the statement's text.

statement_items.description: The lettered or numbered items of the statement, in order, each of which may hold items of its own.

Sp80053StatementItem.title: Sp80053StatementItem
